$comment: W-4 (I-3) — reviewed exception register for the service-client principal check.
Three lists, three different meanings. Do not merge them.
exceptions — a route with a VERIFIED orthogonal authorization model. Reviewed and permanent.
Adding one is a security decision: name the model and cite the line that enforces it.
baseline   — a route with NO verified model. Real W-15 remediation work, frozen 2026-07-31.
FROZEN: entries may be removed as they are fixed, never added.
advisory_transitive_only — reaches a service client through a helper rather than importing one,
so it is outside the enforced predicate. Listed so the set cannot grow silently.
All three lists may only shrink. A stale entry fails the check.
reviewed_by: assignment asg_91e144a61569e4 (mission msn_f74ed02c126c88d7ff, W-4 re-verification); originally asg_d203f547736c16 (mission msn_2d054741a54698fa4c)

exceptions.reason: Read-only action-link metadata. The row is selected BY the bearer token (`.eq("token", token)` at :22) — the token is the authorization, per I-4. No caller-supplied row selector.
Row selected by the bearer token (:17). Expiry and single-use are checked and return 410 (verified by phase 3 §13.1 / I-4).
Row selected by the bearer token from the query string (:20). Same action_links capability as /action/[token].
Row selected by the bearer token from the body (:75), documented as the same raw action_links.token as the /action/[token] URL.
Row selected by the bearer token (:37); validity, consumption and expiry are checked before the write.
Embed bootstrap. `resolvePublicFormEmbedContext(supabase, token)` (:31) is the gate; every subsequent read is scoped to what the token resolved.
Creates a draft tied to the resolved public link (:46). Creates only — no caller-supplied row selector.

Takes a caller-supplied submissionId, but binds it: `verifySubmissionBelongsToPublicEmbed(supabase, ctx, submissionId)` at :58 (GET) and :144 (PATCH) runs before the read/update. This is the subject-bound property I-4 requires.
Same binding check at :114 before the submit path executes.
Token-resolved link scopes the booking write (:30); rate-limited per token (:24).

Svix `Webhook.verify` against RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET at :69, and it returns 400 before `createAdminClient()` is constructed at :91 — no statement reaches the database on an unsigned request. The handler documents that session auth MUST NOT gate it.

GET returning (id, name, slug) for active rows of the platform-global `verticals` table. No org-scoped or personal data, no caller-supplied selector, no write. RLS bypass discloses nothing tenant-specific.
Pricing/addon catalogs for the public booking UI. The org is pinned to ALLOY_PUBLIC_ORG_ID from the environment (:26) — never caller-supplied — and the handler is read-only.
Org pinned to ALLOY_PUBLIC_ORG_ID and 500s without it (:17-20); entity_type is validated against a fixed allow-list (:32-38). Read-only, returns only fields explicitly flagged for public booking.
Unauthenticated vendor application intake. Org pinned to ALLOY_PUBLIC_ORG_ID and 500s without it (:33-37). Creates only — it selects no existing row by a caller-supplied id.

advisory_transitive_only.reason: Public inbound gutter-lead intake. Reaches a service client through `@/lib/supabase` helpers rather than importing a constructor, so it sits outside the enforced predicate. Creates only (contact upsert + opportunity create); marked LEGACY_COMPAT in its own header. Flagged for W-15.

Twilio status callback; delegates to `handleTwilioSmsStatus`, which holds the service client. Webhook model — signature verification lives in the helper, not the route, which is why the route itself shows no principal.
Per-tenant subaccount variant of the same handler and the same model.

Recipient-scoped capability token, not a session principal. The route no longer constructs a service client: `guardTourActionRoute` (:20) holds it and returns it only after `authorizeTourAction` verifies the token hash, the link↔invitation recipient binding, and the action kind. `requiredActions` is the route constant `[view_tour_slots, view_tour_details]` (:16) — never request-supplied — so a decline- or cancel-only token cannot read context. Read-only; discloses labels and status, never a person, opportunity, process or household id.

Same guard-held client and same capability model. Route constant `[view_tour_slots, reschedule_tour]` (:20); the authorized link scopes the availability read, and the guard rate-limits per token under the `slots` budget.

Same guard-held client and same capability model. Route constant `[decline_tour]` (:14). Single-use: `consumeTourAction` closes the credential with a conditional `UPDATE ... WHERE consumed_at IS NULL`. Writes only the invitation's own decline state.

Same guard-held client and same capability model. Route constant `[confirm_tour]` (:19). The booking id comes from the credential via `loadBoundBooking`, never from the request body, so no caller-supplied selector reaches the write.

Same guard-held client and same capability model. Route constant `[reschedule_tour]` (:21). Booking id is credential-bound via `loadBoundBooking`; the requested slot is revalidated against `computeAvailableTourSlots` before `rescheduleTourBooking` runs.

Same guard-held client and same capability model. Route constant `[cancel_tour]` (:16). Booking id is credential-bound via `loadBoundBooking`, and the cancel is single-use through `consumeTourAction`.

Citations spot-verified line-by-line for the two subject-binding entries (:58/:144, :114) and the tour-booking token resolve (:30).
